title: Peak Traffic Intensity
scenario: For every server, identify the day where traffic was higher than the average traffic of the previous 3 days.
tableSchema: logs (srv_id INT, log_date DATE, traffic INT)
hint: Use AVG() OVER window with frame specification.
correctQuery: SELECT srv_id, log_date FROM (SELECT srv_id, log_date, traffic, AVG(traffic) OVER(PARTITION BY srv_id ORDER BY log_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_avg FROM logs) t WHERE traffic > prev_avg;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (srv_id INT, log_date DATE, traffic INT);
